messages:
devon: Heads-up — planning to toggle feature flag `llm-route-v4` as part of the v3.2 rollout tonight in the 23:00-23:30 UTC change window. Ramp plan: 0% -> 5% (5m) -> 20% (10m) -> 50% (remaining soak). Will pin to v3.2-rc2 during the rollout. Release notes: https://redwood/release/3.2 :eyes:

deploybot: Scheduled job created: `ff-ramp-6932109999` for channel eng-platform at 2026-03-22T23:00:00Z. Will emit preflight checks 20m before.

anya: Quick Q — is the fallback a previous model or a lighter quantized variant?

devon: Fallback = v3.1-stable (non-quantized). If we need to degrade we unpin and route to v3.1. Also have a quantized v3.2-q as last-resort low-latency path.

kate: Observability/rollback triggers we agreed on? I can set alerts on this.

devon: Agreed triggers:
- error rate increase > 0.5% absolute over baseline for 5m
- 99th latency > 400ms sustained for 3m
- model token cost jump > 30%/day for this cohort
If any trigger fires, we fast-disable the flag and pin to v3.1.

sam: I'll own watch during the window. Tag me if you need manual rollback. :thumbsup:

lucy: How do we execute fast-disable if metrics spike? Put the exact command here pls.

devon: Run from main ops channel or via deploybot: 
```
/deploybot ff disable llm-route-v4 --immediate --reason "auto/ops rollback"
```
Or via infra tool: 
```
infractl flags set llm-route-v4 false --pin-version v3.1-stable
```

ops_bot: Preflight checklist will post at 22:40 UTC with canary traces, token budgets, and smoke test results.

anya: One more — are we doing sticky session pinning for the canary cohort? If users hit canary and then get routed off, we might confuse evals.

devon: Yes, sticky for 1h for canary cohort only. We'll use session cookie + request fingerprint. That keeps metrics clear.

kate: I'll attach the alert runbook to the deploybot job and add a pager if threshold crosses.

deploybot: Preflight job queued. Will post smoke test output and rollout readiness at 22:40 UTC.

sam: I tested the fast-disable command in staging — works and preserves pin to v3.1. Ran through `infractl` flow.

lucy: Great. One last ask: add a line in release notes about the canary stickiness and fallback behavior. Ops folks rely on that.

devon: Done — release notes updated. Also added the CLI snippets. Link: https://redwood/release/3.2/notes#ff-llm-route-v4

anya: All set from ML side. :party-parrot:

kate: Alerts attached. Pager on-call: kate -> sam (22:55-23:35 UTC).

devon: OK team — preflight at 22:40. I'll start the ramp at 23:00 UTC. If anything anomalous, use the fast-disable command and ping @sam and @devon. Standby.

sam: Copy. On watch.

deploybot: Job `ff-ramp-6932109999` will run the staggered ramp. Canary group: 500 users (~5%). Logs and traces to /canary/6932109999.

lucy: :thumbsup: good luck folks.

devon: If we don't hear issues, we'll proceed to 50% and then hold for a 30m soak before final release. Otherwise we stop and rollback.

ops_bot: Reminder: change window 23:00-23:30 UTC — any extended rollbacks will require on-call approval.

devon: Acknowledged. I'm available on call.
